_note: WHICH SOURCE BOUNDARIES MAKE UP EACH WHOLLAR REGION. The one operator input
in the FSA derivation, and the reason it is a committed file rather than a
form: it is small, it is reviewable in a diff, every entry carries a source
feature id that can be re-fetched, and it is the thing an auditor would ask
to see. scripts/build-geo-regions.mjs reads it and derives the candidate FSA
sets; nothing here is an FSA, and no FSA is ever typed by hand.
A REGION IS SEVERAL FEATURES, not one. Whollar's regions are market areas
named in partner/core/places.js, and they sit at roughly the scale of three
to eight City of Toronto neighbourhoods. Not one of them resolves to a
single source feature by name: there is no 'North York Central' and no
'Downtown Core' in the city's 158 neighbourhoods, and 'Scarborough East' is
Whollar's grouping rather than the city's. So the mapping is one to many and
the operator picks the set.
EVERY REGION NAME HERE MUST BE ONE IN lib/places.js. That is the same
vocabulary partner coverage and campaign creation are held to, and keying
this off it is what stops a third spelling of a place existing anywhere.
The build refuses a name that is not in it.
AN EMPTY features ARRAY IS UNRESOLVED AND THE BUILD FAILS ON IT. Same rule
as the FSA placeholders it replaces: a region nobody has actually looked at
must not quietly produce a cohort somebody can join.

North York Central.note: UNRESOLVED. The derivation was run once against Willowdale West (037), East Willowdale (152), Lansing-Westgate (038), Newtonbrook West (036) and Bayview Village (052) to prove the pipeline, and it produced M2N at 84% and M2K at 73% included, with M2R at 49%, M2M at 34% and M3H for review. Those five features are a starting point and NOT an answer: which of them Whollar means by 'North York Central' is a market decision, not a lookup, and the run is recorded here rather than committed as fact.

Downtown Core.note: UNRESOLVED. Candidates: Yonge-Bay Corridor, Church-Wellesley, Downtown Yonge East, Kensington-Chinatown, University, St Lawrence-East Bayfront-The Islands, Moss Park, Regent Park. Downtown Core is also the region most likely to overlap Downtown East and Downtown West, which are separate names in the same vocabulary; the three have to be decided together or households on the boundary will see two cohorts.

Scarborough East.note: UNRESOLVED. Scarborough is four Whollar regions (Southwest, Centre, East, North) over roughly twenty city neighbourhoods, so this one is a four-way split rather than a lookup.

Richmond Hill South.note: NO SOURCE YET. York Region, not the City of Toronto, so the neighbourhoods dataset does not contain it and neither does any Toronto boundary. CONFIRM-14: either a York Region or Town of Richmond Hill open-data boundary, or an operator-drawn polygon with source recorded as such. Nothing can be derived for this region until one is chosen.

Markham Centre.note: NO SOURCE YET. York Region, as above. CONFIRM-14.
